item.title: 'Pokémon TCG Pocket' Announces Big Update to Address Player Concerns
item.description: If you’ve played the mobile game Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket , you probably have at least two major complaints : the UI is too slow, and the current card set release cadence is overwhelming. It seems that DeNa and The Pokémon Company are working on fixing at least one of these issues.

item.title: 6 Newly Announced Games You Need to Add to Your Steam Wishlist
item.description: Out of all the world premiere-filled gaming streams that happen throughout a year, The Triple-i Initiative has gradually become a personal favorite over time. The event, which focuses exclusively on independent games, is always an unpredictable watch compared to shows like Summer Game Fest. Last week’s Triple-i Initiative stream was no different, showing off 40 games across a jam-packed 45 minutes.

item.title: 'Divided' quest walkthrough in Arc Raiders
item.description: The "Divided" quest in Arc Raiders focuses on finding four separate nomad recordings, spread throughout Pendola Pass. This is the final quest of the Nomadic Envoy's line, introduced with the "Frozen Trail" update, and while it doesn't need to be completed in one round, it's certainly possible. Finding each of the recordings can be a pain though, so we've got all four locations listed here.

item.title: Control Resonant Just Became Remedy’s Fastest-Selling Game of All Time
item.description: Remedy Entertainment's latest mind-bending game, Control Resonant, is a massive sales success for the Finnish developer. Less than a month after the action RPG's release, the studio revealed the game has sold more than 1 million copies.

item.title: One of the Most Intriguing RPGs of 2027 Plays With Time Brilliantly
item.description: The most unique component of Eternal Anima is its time-traveling mechanic, which sends Wade into the past to seek the powers of ancient heroes, allowing him to change the future. The most intriguing aspect of Eternal Anima’s time-manipulation theme, however, comes in the game’s turn-based battles, which offer a compelling new perspective on classic RPG gameplay.

item.title: 25 Years Later, DC's Most Innovative Sci-Fi Show Changed Superheroes Forever
item.description: Bringing Superman to weekly television has never been easy. Special effects rarely matched the movies, and a superhero who could fly presented some obvious budget problems. Then Smallville premiered on The WB on Oct. 16, 2001, and found an ingenious workaround: Don't let Superman fly.

item.title: 'Crystal Lake' Ending Explained: Jason Voorhees' New Origin Story and More
item.description: For one thing, Crystal Lake reshuffles the original timeline, moving Jason's death up from 1957 to 1971, and then compresses the amount of time between that event and the summer camp slaughter that follows.
